newsitem.title: UK: Major to see queen, denies election date set.
newsitem.headline: Major to see queen, denies election date set.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major will see head of state Queen Elizabeth at 1130 GMT on Monday following a meeting of his cabinet, the prime minister's office said.

Major must see the queen to ask for her formal permission to dissolve parliament before calling an election. The Press Association news agency said it would be on May 1 but Major's office denied a date had yet been set.
